checks.name: unsupported_statements
checks.detail: Most draft claims trace to supplied facts and quotes. Claim-29 says the family meeting 'is scheduled for November 4', while the day 3 note says 'Family meeting not yet held; sibling unavailable until November 4.' and 'Family meeting November 4.' The scheduling wording is a reasonable reading but goes slightly beyond the quoted text.

checks.name: source_labeling
checks.detail: Claim-2 is labeled direct_quote, but its text is a paraphrase of the intake wording 'stated a plan to overdose and intent to act'. The label may overstate how literal the claim is.

checks.name: date_consistency
checks.detail: Service dates in the draft claims match the supplied notes: day 1 on 2026-11-01, day 2 on 2026-11-02 (late entry signed November 3), and day 3 on 2026-11-03. Observation step-down to every 15 minutes is dated to day 2 in the draft and to November 2 in the day 3 note.

checks.name: requested_vs_authorized_periods
checks.detail: The draft does not conflate the requested period (November 4 through November 6) with the authorized period (November 1 through November 3). The only November 4 reference is the family meeting date.

checks.name: contradictions
checks.detail: The draft presents the intent conflict between the intake and the day 1 progress note without resolving it, and it records the risk trajectory from high acute risk to moderate risk on day 3 without contradicting the source notes.

checks.name: stale_output
checks.detail: Open questions on the sertraline dose, discharge plan, unsigned treatment plan, and late-entry day 2 note match the supplied documents. No reliance on superseded content was found.
